notes: SUNToken has no constructor arguments and mints its entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 SUN with 18 decimals to msg.sender once. The launch factory handles distribution externally; SUNToken makes no allocation transfers. Transfers from PoolManager 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951 to any other address, including buys and liquidity withdrawals, send a 0.5% tax rounded down to whole minor units directly to 0xeeaf04a41ac45a605e30dc6a41a44e6f75ddf8b6; the recipient receives the remainder. Transfers to PoolManager, including sells, pool seeds and PoolManager self-transfers, and ordinary wallet transfers are untaxed. The tax rate, recipient and PoolManager are compile-time constants. There is no owner, admin, post-constructor minting, burn, proxy or application contract. The pool pairs SUN with IMD at a fixed 1.25% fee. initialPrice records the SUN-as-currency0 provenance quote; the launch derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei, totalSupply and deployed currency order.
